findings.title: Stacking differs between mobile and web POS
findings.detail: On mobile, a NO_STACK coupon/promo (stackable:false, e.g. CRM coupons) applied first causes the synthetic staff discount to be rejected. On web, memberTypeDiscount always applies alongside the coupon. Align the behaviour or document the difference explicitly.

findings.title: Customer display discount leaves out the type discount
findings.detail: WebPOSScreen ~1592 discountOverride = billDiscAmt + itemDiscountTotal leaves memberTypeDiscount out while grandOverride includes it. Coupons already behave this way; record as a follow-up for the customer-display workflow (out of scope here).

findings.title: No chat icon on the mobile member list
findings.detail: MemberListScreen added only a call button; WebCRM has call + sms. Add a 44px chatbubble -> sms: button.

findings.title: New web screen bypasses the shared UI kit
findings.detail: WebMemberTypeScreen uses its own buttons/cards/badges/banner instead of @/components/ui Button/Card/Badge/Alert, a local TOUCH=44 instead of ComponentSize.button.md, and raw values (paddingVertical 2, maxWidth 420/460, flexBasis 260). A rewritten line in WebCRMScreen keeps the hex '#6B5B57'.

findings.title: Web POS discount composition has no tests
findings.detail: No test covers WebPOS grandTotal/discountTotal with a type discount + coupon + points, and the UI was not run. Do the manual walkthrough before release.
